scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/server alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen: uv run python -m studio.api.export_openapi > packages/api-client/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @opsis/api-client gen
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check apps/server && pnpm --filter @opsis/web lint && pnpm --filter @opsis/web typecheck
